title: Great Rotation Happening Now: This Sector ‘Is Over’ | Thomas Hayes
speaker: Thomas Hayes (Great Hill Capital)

macro_themes.view: Memory and chips are commodities and foreign capacity will crush prices, so the AI capex trade will hurt its spenders.
Money is moving to defensives, small caps, value, international and bonds, like 2000-2006.
A 5.2% guaranteed 10y vs a ~5% equity earnings yield is pulling pensions into bonds.
Yields are up on growth and oil-driven inflation; an end to the war would quickly drop the 10y to ~4.75%.
Sentiment is terrible but spending is strong, so discretionary has priced in the worst case.

calls.reason: Memory is a commodity: high prices cure high prices, and Chinese, Korean and Japanese makers will flood the market; the semi/memory cycle collapses every ~4 years.
calls.quote: High prices cure high prices... they wouldn't flood the market with memory and flood the market with commodity semiconductor chips.

calls.reason: Out of tech; the semiconductor/AI-capex trade is crowded and rolling over after a dead-cat bounce, and capex spenders historically lose.
calls.quote: We're out of tech... that trade in the short term is over... the commodity trade within the AI trade is done.

calls.reason: Lowest-cost US natural gas producer near Gulf LNG terminals and East Texas data centers; reserves worth far more than the market cap.
calls.quote: We think it can be a$4 to $60 stock over the next 3 to 5 years. Opinion not advice

calls.reason: Cheapest AI play: stakes in Asian AI startups like Moonshot not priced in, China property bottoming plus stimulus, triple-digit AI revenue growth.
calls.quote: we have a company called Alibaba, which is the cheapest AI play in the world.

calls.reason: Starlink Mobile can't work inside buildings without towers; stock re-rated and 'just beginning', 5.3% dividend while you wait.
calls.quote: that stock galloped you know 20% in 2 or 3 days and it's just beginning 5.3% dividend yield while you wait.

calls.reason: Brad Jacobs building-supplies roll-up; accretive deals whether housing stays weak or recovers; buying every share they can.
calls.quote: every share that comes available that we can get our hands on, we're getting our hands on.

calls.reason: Largest pure-play warehousing company using robots/AI to lift margins; an AI beneficiary rather than capex spender.
calls.quote: those are going to continue to fly and be beneficiaries of of AI in the middle innings of the AI trade.

calls.reason: Out-of-favor defensive staple showing up in their framework, like Buffett buying staples in 2000.
calls.quote: all the stuff that's showing up for us to buy like Dagio like Baxter healthcare staples

calls.reason: Out-of-favor defensive healthcare name showing up in their framework for the next 6-12 months.
calls.quote: all the stuff that's showing up for us to buy like Dagio like Baxter healthcare staples

calls.condition: Especially if the rise in yields slows or reverses.
calls.reason: Small caps had their second-worst quarter vs the S&P this century while ISM is expanding and $8T sits in money markets; nimble AI adopters with operating leverage.
calls.quote: small caps are like a beach ball held underwater... that are going to absolutely explode higher we believe over the next 9 to 16 months

calls.reason: Expects a bull market under the surface in the 'unmagnificent 493' but only modest index gains as the 5-10 AI megacaps consolidate or fall.
calls.quote: the indices are only going up modestly because those five or 10 stocks are consolidating and taking a breather

calls.condition: If the Iran war ended, the 10y would drop to ~4.75%; if 8% nominal growth isn't sustainable, 4.25-4.50%.
calls.reason: Yields driven by both growth/capital demand and oil-driven inflation expectations; rotation into bonds already under way and yields stopping going up.
calls.quote: if the war ended tomorrow, I think the 10-year yield would be immediately down to 475.
